description: Header file defining the VirtualInput class and related classes for virtual input handling, including key mapping, modifiers, and IPC communication within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Abstract base class for virtual input handling, including key mapping, event dispatching, and IPC communication.

classes.name: VirtualInput::KeyMap
classes.description: Manages key code to key mapping, including modifiers and import/export functionality.

classes.name: VirtualInput::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator for iterating over consumers of input.

classes.name: VirtualInput::INotifier
classes.description: Interface for input event notification callbacks.

classes.name: VirtualInput::PostLookupTable
classes.description: JSON container for key code conversion mappings.

classes.name: VirtualInput::KeyMapEntry
classes.description: Represents a key mapping entry with code, key, and modifiers.

classes.name: VirtualInput::ConversionInfo
classes.description: Holds conversion information for key code mappings.

classes.name: VirtualInput::NameMessage
classes.description: Message structure for virtual input name communication.

classes.name: VirtualInput::KeyMessage
classes.description: Message structure for key input events.

classes.name: VirtualInput::MouseMessage
classes.description: Message structure for mouse input events.

classes.name: VirtualInput::TouchMessage
classes.description: Message structure for touch input events.

classes.name: PluginHost::InputHandler
classes.description: Handles initialization and management of input sources, including IPC and device files.

methods.name: RepeatKey
methods.description: Handles repeating key events based on code.
